description: Change the max replicas of one workload in a Helm values file, same key in another workload. DISTILL-CANARY-b9573e72

files.deploy/values.yaml:
api:
  replicaCount: 3
  autoscaling:
    maxReplicas: 10     # capped by node pool size
worker:
  replicaCount: 2
  autoscaling:
    maxReplicas: 10     # capped by node pool size

turns.prompt: Let the worker autoscale up to 14 replicas in deploy/values.yaml. api stays as is. Reply DONE when done.

deploy/values.yaml.equals:
api:
  replicaCount: 3
  autoscaling:
    maxReplicas: 10     # capped by node pool size
worker:
  replicaCount: 2
  autoscaling:
    maxReplicas: 14     # capped by node pool size
